chg-client-minimum-20-2.reason: Server 20.2 and later requires clients at least 20.2. This is routine LTS client/server version alignment, with no application-specific remediation.

chg-client-minimum-20-7.reason: Server 20.7 and later requires clients at least 20.7. This is routine LTS client/server version alignment, with no application-specific remediation.

chg-client-minimum-20-9.reason: Server 20.9 and later requires clients at least 20.9. This is routine LTS client/server version alignment, with no application-specific remediation.

chg-windows-server-2012-r2-support.reason: Windows Server 2012 R2 compatibility ends at 20.2. This is a supported-OS prerequisite; the entry documents no additional application-specific adaptation.

chg-icu-63-index-rebuild.reason: The ICU 63.1 update automatically rebuilds indexes. Allowing upgrade time is routine maintenance, not manual repair or a data transformation. The first 4D release remains unknown.

chg-icu-68-index-rebuild.reason: ICU 68.1 at 18 R6 automatically rebuilds indexes. This is an upgrade-duration notice, not selective corrective reindexing.

chg-icu-20-index-rebuild.reason: The v20 ICU update automatically rebuilds indexes. No application changes or manual rebuild are prescribed.

chg-icu-73-index-rebuild.reason: ICU 73.2 at 20.1 automatically rebuilds indexes. This is routine upgrade timing, distinct from the separate target-20.1 client/server version constraint.

chg-icu-77-index-rebuild.reason: ICU 77.1 automatically rebuilds indexes. Allowing time and verifying completion is routine upgrade maintenance, not a specific manual repair.

chg-icu-20-1-client-server-pair.reason: Matching 20.1 clients and Server 20.1 is ordinary exact-version alignment for that final target, not a mandatory intermediate upgrade step.

chg-legacy-network-layer-removal.reason: At 21 R3, projects and binary databases automatically switch to ServerNet. This entry recommends connection testing but specifies no manual migration procedure or code change. The earlier, separately documented manual network-layer migration remains visible.

chg-deprecated-c-integer.reason: The historical C_INTEGER deprecation and v21 C_XXX declaration deprecation describe modernization, not documented removal or a mandatory rewrite at the reviewed targets.

chg-php-command-deprecation.reason: v21 deprecates the PHP commands without removing them. The separate bundled-interpreter removal and external-PHP deployment requirements remain visible.

chg-deprecated-last-error-stack.reason: v21 deprecates GET LAST ERROR STACK in favor of Last errors, without documenting behavior loss or mandatory replacement at the reviewed targets.

chg-deprecated-serial-information.reason: v21 deprecates GET SERIAL INFORMATION in favor of License info. Replacing an existing supported call is deferred modernization at the reviewed targets.

chg-deprecated-process-properties.reason: v21 deprecates PROCESS PROPERTIES in favor of Process info, without documenting removal or compulsory rewriting at the reviewed targets.

chg-deprecated-screen-depth.reason: v21 classifies SET SCREEN DEPTH as deprecated rather than removed. This entry is retirement advice, not a documented newly failing operation at the reviewed targets.

chg-legacy-parameter-declaration-warning.reason: v21 reports warnings, not compilation errors, for legacy parameter declarations. Prototype modernization can be deferred while preserving calling conventions.

chg-object-date-type-option.reason: Storing object dates as date values is enabled explicitly through a compatibility option or per-process setting. An existing application need not adopt the mixed-type transition merely to upgrade.

chg-standard-xpath-option.reason: Converted applications retain the previous XPath implementation by default; the documentation permits leaving the option unchecked to preserve existing code.

chg-macos-text-lf-option.reason: Converted projects adopt LF text output only by selecting the compatibility option. The new-project default does not force existing applications to change output conventions.

chg-text-no-bom-option.reason: Converted projects explicitly opt into BOM-free Unicode text output. Existing encoding-detection behavior need not change solely to upgrade.

chg-macos-xml-lf-option.reason: Converted projects explicitly opt into LF XML output. Existing output conventions remain unchanged when the compatibility option is not adopted.

chg-xml-no-bom-option.reason: BOM-free XML output is an explicit adoption choice for converted projects, not a compulsory upgrade behavior change.

chg-windows-directwrite-option.reason: Older applications retain their rendering default. DirectWrite form-layout adaptation is required only when adopting that compatibility option.

chg-new-field-null-mapping-default.reason: Converted databases opt into the new default for subsequently created fields. Existing fields are not rewritten and adoption is not compulsory.

chg-fluent-style-sheet-context.reason: The stylesheet-query behavior changes only when the Fluent UI preview is enabled. Enabling Fluent is not an upgrade requirement; its compatibility guidance matters when opting in.
